title: Hotels with a Pantheon view: which room to book
metaDescription: Three Rome hotels near the Pantheon with view rooms, the exact room category to book at each, and the standard rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with a Pantheon view, and which room to book
dek: Three hotels in Rome's historic centre, two on Piazza della Rotonda and one a short walk away. For each one we list the exact room category sold with the view, and the standard and classic rooms that look elsewhere.
teaser: Two hotels name their Pantheon view categories, and one room is only described as facing it by a travel magazine.

decoder.text: At the Hotel Albergo del Senato, Oyster says the Standard Double Rooms lack a Pantheon view, while the Superior Double Rooms have Pantheon views.
The Junior Suite at the Antico Albergo del Sole Al Pantheon is sold on Trip.com with no view named. The Deluxe Suite Annex has Pantheon View in its name.
The Classic Room at The Pantheon Iconic is sold with no view named. Luxury Travel Advisor says the Pantheon Suite overlooks the Pantheon, but no category name says so.

faq.q: Which hotels sell rooms with a Pantheon view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026, two sell room categories with a Pantheon view in their description: the Antico Albergo del Sole Al Pantheon and the Hotel Albergo del Senato. A travel magazine says the Pantheon Suite at The Pantheon Iconic overlooks the Pantheon.

faq.q: Which room should I book for a Pantheon view?
faq.a: At the Antico Albergo del Sole Al Pantheon, book the Deluxe Suite Annex Pantheon View or the Imperial Suite Ariosto Pantheon View. At the Hotel Albergo del Senato, book the Superior Double Rooms. Oyster says those have Pantheon views plus bathrobes.

faq.q: Is the Pantheon Suite confirmed to face the Pantheon?
faq.a: Not by the room list we opened. A travel magazine says it overlooks the Pantheon, and Private Upgrades advises asking for a Pantheon-facing room when you book.

faq.q: Do all rooms at the Albergo del Senato face the Pantheon?
faq.a: No. Oyster says the Standard Single and Standard Double Rooms lack a Pantheon view. Time Out says many front rooms have an unobstructed view and recommends asking for Room 204.
